answers.answer: She describes her heritage as primarily German with a strain of English ('mostly German with a little English lace at the edges'). Her grandfather Otto Meyer immigrated to Baltimore in 1908 at age 22 from the Grand Duchy of Baden (near Freiburg), settled in Toledo first then moved to Adrian for factory work, was a UAW union man. The WWII-era language loss: her father and his brothers stopped speaking German around 1942-43; by the time Deeva was born in 1940, German was 'gone from the household' — 'I never heard a sentence of German in our house growing up.' Grandma Elsa was Schmidt before marriage; Mother's side were Schmidts from Ohio.
cited_evidence: messenger Deeva: 'Grandma Elsa was Schmidt before she married... Father's family were also German — the Meyers — though Grandpa Otto was the immigrant in that line.'
messenger Deeva: 'Grandpa Otto always said he came from a town near Freiburg... He settled in Toledo first then moved to the Adrian area for factory work.'
messenger Deeva: 'Father stopped speaking it around 1942 or 1943... By the time I was born in 1940 it was just gone from the household.'

answers.answer: Watching the 2020 George Floyd video she could not stop thinking about Daniel — 'what it would mean if something happened to him just because of who he is.' That summer prompted her to begin the NAACP giving (via Brian), and at Christmas 2021 she had a real conversation with Keisha (Brian's wife since 2021) about race in America. Durability evidence: she sustains the NAACP gift annually, keeps reading on her own ('I told her I wanted to keep learning on my own so she didn't have to carry the weight of teaching me'), and explicitly references Eleanor as the first person of color to live on her block in 62 years.

answers.answer: Born 1940 in Adrian, Michigan, raised in an intact German-American family (father in UAW factory work, Rosie-the-Riveter mother who worked the B-24 wing-panel line at Willow Run 1942-45). Graduated Adrian High in 1958, two years at Siena Heights (Dominican Sisters' business administration program) 1958-60, married Harold in 1961, moved to Saline in 1964 when Daniel was a baby and Kathy was two. The arc is fully Michigan-rooted: Adrian → Siena Heights (Adrian) → Saline. Sixty-two years on the same Saline street.
